bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to arts and cultural heritage; appropriating money for the Lake County Veterans Memorial Park.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; LAKE COUNTY VETERANS MEMORIAL PARK.

$40,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to Lake County to plan a veterans memorial park that recognizes and honors veterans and Minnesota history.
